parole.significato: calamity, formidable thing, something nasty, misfortune
parole.testo: From Classical Syriac ܦܬܟܪܐ (pəṯaḵrā, “idol, likeness”), from Old Persian 𐎱𐎫𐎡𐎣𐎼 (p-t-i-k-r /⁠patikaraʰ⁠/, “sculpted image; likeness”), something execrable in Christian circles, hence the meaning in Arabic.
From Classical Syriac ܐܦܕܢܐ (ʾāppaḏnā), from Old Persian 𐎠𐎱𐎭𐎠𐎴 (apadāna), thus doublet of إِيوَان (ʔīwān).
